headline: NBR exchange rate valid 18 September 2026: 1 euro = 5.2601 lei. Leu gains ground slightly
summary: The National Bank of Romania published the exchange rate for 18 September 2026, with the euro at 5.2601 lei. The euro was down 0.07% from the previous day.
why: The leu-euro rate matters for Romanian importers, exporters and borrowers with euro-denominated debt.
